Frontend E2E on preview URL with seed account (membre.test@careeros.dev): /careeros unauth -> /connexion redirect OK, login via auth-tab-login + auth-submit-btn works, dashboard renders dashboard-title, stat-total, 1 application-row-* for seed user; opening pack loads pack-title + header-ips + header-priority; all 8 tabs present (pack-tab-decision/ats/cv_ats/cv_humain/letter/questions/star/simulation) and each has <section>-copy-btn/-docx-btn/-pdf-btn. DOCX and PDF downloads triggered successfully (Analyse-ATS.docx, Analyse-ATS.pdf). pipeline-status-select change to 'postule' persists after reload; restored to 'a_postuler'. issues: Privacy banner at bottom may overlap action buttons on narrow viewports (known, user-dismissible via 'J'ai compris')

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: brute-force lockout keyed on (ip:email) is correct and expires after 15 min via LOCKOUT; TTL index on login_attempts.updated_at (86400s) cleans stale entries. OK.
auth.py uses JWT HS256 with JWT_SECRET from env and Bearer tokens (correct for cross-site frontend/backend). _public excludes password_hash. OK.
ips.py:compute_ips is deterministic, pure function — knockout cap at 40 enforced before priority computation; priority logic matches spec (A: >=70 AND goal_fit>=6 AND !ko; B: >=50 AND !ko; else C).

router.py:_run_pack uses asyncio.gather with return_exceptions=True — partial failures are preserved per-part in errors{} and overall status becomes 'partial' instead of hard-failing the entire pack. Good resilience design.
router.py:create_pack validates CV>=80 chars (falls back to Career Memory cv_text if body cv_text empty), offer_text>=80 OR offer_url provided, and network whitelist. Covers all documented 400 paths.
router.py applications query excludes {_id:0, inputs:0} on list to keep payload small; _summary flattens decision.poste/entreprise/ats for the row. OK.
router.py exposes PATCH /applications/{id}/status with pipeline whitelist — invalid returns 400; timeline is append-only. OK.

Potential improvement (non-blocking): _run_pack re-raises ValueError when offer URL fetch fails AND no offer_text — the resulting status becomes 'error' with errors.pack set, but the pack row remains in list. Frontend handles this via Pending(error=…). Fine.

Frontend AuthPage: controlled inputs with React state; `page.fill` without delay sometimes fails to trigger onChange on React 18 controlled inputs — not a product bug, test flake fixed by using `page.type` with delay. Not an action item.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, redirect guard, dashboard, pack view, 8 tabs, DOCX+PDF downloads, pipeline status persistence, Career Memory persistence, new pack CV prefill, header careeros-btn, registration flow)
